content: Saanvi Pillai called insurance agent Anita Sharma to add the Critical-Illness Rider to her policy, which adds a $45 monthly premium and $50,000 in additional coverage, bringing her total coverage to $250,000 effective November 15, 2026. Saanvi also verified that her husband Rajesh remains the policy beneficiary and provided verbal consent to bind the rider via her existing auto-debit payment method.

action_items: Send a confirmation email to the customer regarding the rider addition
